capabilities: Convert Markdown to rich-text HTML with all styles inlined
Preview the styled output in a side pane with line-based scroll sync
Copy the HTML for pasting into the WeChat editor
Choose from four built-in Chinese typography themes
Add, edit, delete and export custom CSS themes in settings
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not reformat Markdown text; it converts notes into styled HTML for pasting into the WeChat editor.
extras: The README includes a full Chinese-language section duplicating the English content. The fork switched the build from rollup to esbuild because the old chain no longer works on current Node.
intentEvidence: Forked from imhaiqiao/obsidian-convert-markdown-to-html-plugin — thanks to the original author Haiqiao.
motivation: The author forked the original converter to add Chinese typography themes and WeChat-specific adaptations, since the core conversion and preview logic came from the original project.
problem: WeChat's editor only accepts inline styles and strips pseudo-elements, pseudo-classes and media queries, so pasted Markdown loses its formatting and must be restyled by hand.

relations.evidence: Forked from imhaiqiao/obsidian-convert-markdown-to-html-plugin — thanks to the original author Haiqiao.

summary: Converts Markdown to rich-text HTML ready for the WeChat Official Account editor, with live side-pane preview, one-click copy, and Chinese typography themes.
